channels.title: How to apply
channels.email_hint: Write to {address} with your documents attached.
channels.ats_hint: Fill the {provider} form on the employer's site.
channels.manual_hint: Apply on the employer's page, using the kit below.

mark_applied_hint: Use this once you have sent your application on their page.

kit.title: Apply kit
kit.no_documents: No verified PDFs yet. Render your documents in the Studio first.

email.title: Send by email
email.unavailable: The email draft could not be prepared.
email.no_account: Connect a mailbox in Connections to send applications.
email.subject: Subject
email.no_attachments: No verified PDFs yet — send after rendering your documents.
email.not_ready: Fix the documents below in the Studio before sending.
email.sent: Sent. Your application moved to Applied (message {id}).

pending: Not verified yet: {kinds}. Fix the checks and render them in the Studio.
failed: That apply step did not go through.

ats.title: Fill this form with Boba
ats.opt_in_warning: Boba opens your own Chrome in a separate window on a Boba profile and fills the form while you watch. It never presses submit, never solves a CAPTCHA and never signs in for you.
ats.filled: Filled {count} fields and attached {documents}. Check the window, then press submit yourself.
ats.handoff_captcha: The page has a CAPTCHA. Boba stopped — finish the form in the window.
ats.handoff_login_wall: The page wants you to sign in. Boba stopped — sign in and finish in the window.
ats.handoff_unknown: Boba had no confident answer for “{label}”. Finish that field yourself.
ats.handoff_missing_document: Boba has no verified document to attach for “{label}”. Add it in the Studio, or attach it yourself.
ats.needs_check: Boba could not find a confirmation. The card is marked Needs check — open it to verify.
ats.failed: That browser step did not go through.

answers.title: Screening answers to approve
answers.edit_hint: Confirm it as it stands, or edit it and save.
answers.failed: That answer could not be saved.
